report.summary:
daedalus/metrics.py: Provides escalation metering by logging routing outcomes to an append-only JSONL file and surfacing a fallback rate alarm.
tests/test_storage_watermark.py: Tests the storage availability check including disk usage, watermark, env override, and exception handling.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/metrics.py|The most load-bearing practitioner warning: a broken verifier can quietly route ~90% of traffic to the expensive model with no error and no alert.
